steps: Identify initial nuclei N_0 = 48 \times 10^{23} and final nuclei N = 6 \times 10^{23} at t = 3 min.
Use the radioactive decay law N = N_0 (1/2)^{t/T_{1/2}}.
Substitute the values: 6 \times 10^{23} = 48 \times 10^{23} (1/2)^{3/T_{1/2}}, which simplifies to 1/8 = (1/2)^{3/T_{1/2}}.
Match the calculated mean life with Option (B).
